AMAX_REF.method: IR72 AMAXTB is constant at 40 throughout DVS 0..2. Use 40 as the 8.1 reference cap, also the explicit upstream rice_eu AMAX_REF. This is a structural conversion, not a proof of equivalent 7.2/8.1 assimilation.

KN.method: Transfer the upstream rice_eu nitrogen extinction coefficient to IR72 as an explicit cross-ecotype assumption. Not an IR72 observation or fitted coefficient.

notes: IR72 already inherits AMAX_SLP=3.24 and AMAX_LNB=0 from upstream GenericC3.
Keep native WOFOST81 assimilation; do not substitute 7.x assimilation or a different model.
No local field-yield accuracy is claimed. Sensitivity runs must be reported separately from calibration.
